# Mile High Junk Removal

> Locally owned junk removal company serving Denver, CO and the Front Range (Aurora, Lakewood, Parker, Littleton, Arvada, Westminster, Broomfield, Thornton, Centennial, Highlands Ranch, Castle Rock, and surrounding areas). Offers same-day and next-day junk removal, hauling, and cleanout services with free estimates, donation/recycling-first disposal, and full insurance coverage. Founded by Gerardo and Ruby in late 2023.

Contact: 303-990-1812 (call or text) · contact@milehighjunkremoval.net
Service area: Denver metro and Front Range, Colorado
